title: Glyphastic!
description: By far the best implementation of the Glyph-based magic system from The Owl House!
body:
## The Purpose
The mod adds new items called Glyph Scrolls, that on use do different abilities/actions that can be used in pvp, traveling, or just for utility

## ➕ Additions:
- **Blank Glyph**: A template for creating usable **Glyph Scrolls** on the **Glyph Inscriber
**
- **Glyph Scroll**: When used, does an action dependant on what glyph combination is inscribed on it
- A full _Glyph Combo_ system, 13+ Total handcrafted actions, _Imperfect Combination_ system
- An easy to use Glyph Inscriber block, with a cool GUI

## Usage
- Craft Blank Glyphs by surrounding amethyst shards with paper
- Craft a glyph inscriber block
- Use the glyph inscriber's GUI to write a glyph combination to the Blank:
  - Place The Blank in the center slot of the GUI
  - Drag and Drop the glyphs from the "palette" at the left onto the bigger surrounding slots
  - A written Glyph Scroll should appear at the output slot if there is any glyphs to write
  - The Imperfect Combination System makes it much easier to search for usable glyph sets
  - The Output Scroll dynamically shows what ability it has depending on the glyphs written
  - _Note: Glyph order in the GUI doesn't matter, what matters is what glyphs are written_
  - 1 Scroll craft costs 1 Experience level, to craft a scroll - just take it
  - To Bulk-Craft scrolls - Shift + Click the output scroll
- Use the outputted glyph scroll item to use the written action (1 out of 13), this also removes the used scroll

## Registry
For all the glyph combinations there are 13 different actions to match, here are they (without the combination)
- Overgrowth - Acts a giant bone meal
- Ember - Creates a ring of fire around you
- Frost Cover - Covers natural blocks around you with ice
- Illumination - Gives the user Night Vision
- Regeneration - Gives the user Regeneration
- Launch - Propells the user in their look direction
- Shockwave - Propells entities in range from the user, ignites affected entities
- Explosion - Creates an explosion roughly the same power as regular TNT
- Invisibility - Gives the user a new effect: "Pure Invisibility" - Hides both the player and the held item
- Ascension - Massively launches the user upwards, when on the top - gives Slow Falling
- Nature's Strength - Gives the user Sterngth 2
- Iceful Raise - Creates an ice pillar below the user
- Flash - Flashes White the screen of players in range, has a massive delay

Most of the actions have a delay/cooldown for balance reasons

## Coming Soon
I plan on making certain additions in the future mod versions, here are the current ideas so you know what to expect:
- Glyph Placement System - Activates the scroll's ability when walked over
- Per-World Glyph Combinations - Will determine the glyph combinations for hardcoded actions dynamically based on the world seed (So no memorizing!)
